name: KiCad JLCPCB Interface
description: Browse JLCPCB/LCSC-linked schematic components and select them in Eeschema.

actions.name: JLCPCB Component Properties
actions.description: Open catalogue details for the one selected symbol carrying an LCSC custom property.

actions.name: JLCPCB Component Overview
actions.description: Browse all linked schematic components and estimate total cost and stock coverage.

actions.name: JLCPCB Add or Update Component
actions.description: With one symbol selected, review and populate catalogue fields without changing its pinout; with no selection, search by LCSC code or a free-text query, accept suggested mappings or choose a KiCad Library:Symbol and add a project-local copy.
